decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel builds directly on the firm's core cryptography and authentication know-how, so in-house R&D lets it interpret early results and refine the product.
Mobile PDF signing is close to the established offer and fits the strategic move toward online contract signing, which the firm's signature expertise can absorb and improve.
The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is the integrating backbone of the firm's portfolio and draws on its deepest related knowledge.
The email-to-app delivery robot extends the firm's secure-communication base and supports binding mobile communication, though it is a narrower add-on that could later be folded into other offerings.
The QR-code hardware token uses the firm's existing hardware and transaction-signing experience, but hardware's lower margins and the shift toward app-based authentication pose a moderate risk.
The payment network compliance suite builds on the firm's regulatory and security knowledge for demanding customers, so its R&D capacity can adapt it as requirements evolve.
